Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D Godot game menu background, a single full-bleed landscape image, 2048x1152 preferred, no UI compositing.
Create an illustrated background for BRASA, a hand-painted fighting/adventure game with animal martial artists and lantern-lit old stone places. This image is the journey courtyard for the first Story chapter, called the Path of Lanterns. View from a sheltered old training court out toward a winding mountain road marked by small amber lanterns, worn sandstone, roots, cypress and moss. A broken practice shield leaning at far right and a rope with a faded cloth at upper right suggest past training. No people, no animals.
Art direction: painterly 2D illustration with deliberate brush texture, tactile worn stone, oxidized bronze, dark wood and restrained stitched cloth. Earthy warm ochre stone, deep petroleum teal distant mountains, candlelight and cool dusk. Rich atmospheric adventure-book feeling, controlled detail, not photoreal or 3D or pixel art.
Composition: camera near eye level, wide cinematic environment. Foreground lower half is a clean open stone terrace, subtly lit on the RIGHT CENTER, reserved for a separately rendered large fighter. LEFT third is dark, quiet low-detail wall/foliage and atmospheric negative space reserved for readable live game text. Top 20% is subdued dusk sky with no focal objects to allow header. Depth and distant path should remain visible around the central UI. Put architectural narrative details at far edges; do not fill the center with props. Strong illustration as a physical place, no frames/cards/buttons within this background.
Absolutely no letters, numbers, typography, pseudo-writing, watermark, game title, UI, logos, icons or characters. The game will render all text and characters separately.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production background plate for a 2D Godot adventure-fighting game's Story encounter menu. Single full-bleed 2048x1152 landscape preferred.
Create the storm chapter environment of BRASA. A weathered stone training terrace beside enormous old roots, rusted iron guardrails and a damaged practice shield, overlooking misty blue-teal mountain cliffs under a storm clearing at twilight. Two copper lanterns warm the wet slate and moss. Small broken training objects near the far edges hint at a heavy, patient guardian. The central-right foreground is an OPEN natural stone platform, well lit enough to place a separately rendered large anthropomorphic bear martial artist there, but DO NOT draw any fighter or character.
Maintain the established hand-painted 2D storybook game-art style: painterly brush marks, tactile stone/moss/rust/cloth, atmospheric depth, restrained warm ochre/amber lights against deep desaturated teal and mineral blue. Clean large masses before fine details, no photorealism, no 3D rendering, no pixel art.
Practical composition: left 40% low-contrast dark rock/shadow, kept quiet to receive native text; right center strong space and light around the unseen fighter position. Top20% dark cloud/quiet foliage for native heading; lower20% subtle slate ground for route controls. A route of worn stepping stones leads into the distance through a root-framed broken gateway toward center-right. Interesting narrative props at outer margins only. Feel like standing at a real place before a difficult encounter, not a dashboard or card composition.
No text, labels, numbers, letterlike markings, logos, watermarks, interface controls, frames, human figures or animals. No fake writing on props. ALL labels and fighter artwork are added separately by Godot.
